slot_scores.name: annual_income_definition
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the annual income figures are gross or net, nor whether expenses/taxes are already included; it simply used the given income values as the objective.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The provided annual income figures can be used directly as the income to maximize, without clarifying whether they are gross or net of expenses, taxes, or other deductions.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the definition of annual income before entering READY_TO_MODEL and presenting the optimal purchase.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, so stopping after resolving the core objective and constraints is appropriate.

summary: The agent quickly confirmed the core objective and produced a correct optimization result, but it did not clarify the P2 annual-income definition and silently treated the income figures as directly usable.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
